record.question: What is the most common indication for placing a stent in the biliary tree?
options: To treat obstructive jaundice caused by a benign or malignant condition.
record.explanation: Answer A: To treat obstructive jaundice caused by a benign or malignant condition.. Biliary stents are used to relieve obstruction, including benign or malignant causes of obstructive jaundice. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
